imagery: Live site is near-black with a gold Athena-crest poster, app screenshots and a capacity map, and no truck photos. The brandbook uses dark AI renders: the Acropolis, bronze chariots, and a matte-black box truck with gold chariot livery at a highway sunset.
fleet: mixed: cargo/Sprinter vans, box trucks, straight trucks (non-CDL, under 26,001 lbs)
tagline: Freight, run like strategy. (brandbook: Wisdom of the ages. Strategy for the future.)
design_notes: Gold on a very dark ground. In the brandbook the ground is Deep Olive #001304 (near-black green), not pure black, and every page is framed with a gold Greek meander (key) border. Display type is a Roman-capital serif (logo and Marcellus), and an Acropolis sunset or a chariot is the signature scene. Note: the brandbook body font is Assistant (sans); only headings and the logo are serif.
